text.p: Chemical firm Alkimia said on Monday it had begun the process of raising its capital to 16.093 million dinars from 14.630 million dinars through the incorporation of reserves.

It said 146,300 new shares worth 10 dinars each were being distributed free of charge to current shareholders. These include the state-controlled holding Groupe Chimique, and three privately-owned groups, Doghri, Chaibi and Driss.

Alkimia made a 7.629 million dinars net profit in 1996, up 8.71 percent from a revised 7.076 million dinars in 1995. It distributed a 3.445 dinars dividend and super dividend, below the 4.035 dinars distributed for 1995.
The company manufactures and trades chemical inputs for detergents. ($=1.09 dinar)
